base_member_text: The concentration fields are multiplied by 100 but displayed against caxis [0.0 0.01] (L60, L62, L72, L74) with a colorbar labeled plain ' c ' — the effective displayed range is raw C in [0, 1e-4]; the units and the reason for the x100 scaling are not stated.

The colorbar is still labeled only 'c', so intended fraction-versus-percent units are unresolved.

base_member_text: The 1 s output interval implied by the title (L50) must match the case input; unverifiable here.
dep is loaded from dep_00000 (L5) — a time-stamped depth output name implying morphology updates — but depth evolution is not shown.

mov(num).cdata stores unresized 300-dpi frames for all 75 frames (L82-L85), unlike siblings that resize to 576x1024; memory-heavy and the commented vidHeight/vidWidth (L23-L24) confirm resizing was dropped.

audit_member_text: Graphics-state accumulation defect across L30 and L47-L77: clf runs only once before the frame loop, while every subplot executes hold on and never clears or releases it. Each iteration therefore layers another pcolor and creates additional colorbars on persistent axes, causing growing memory/object counts and stale stacked graphics across the 75-frame video.
All propeller/no-propeller arrays are plotted on coordinates sized from output/dep_00000 at L5-L13 without shape checks; a mismatched comparison run fails or misaligns.
MATLAB pcolor at L47, L60, and L72 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces.
